svg.title: Three collinear attractors in their original coordinates
svg.desc: Original E(c,n), using f_t(z)=t+z/c and complete depth-eight prefixes. Left: n=4, c=(3+i sqrt(11))/2. Middle: n=5, c=1+2i. Right: n=3, c=3+3i. Colors identify the first digit. Each panel has an independently fitted view. These finite-resolution visual approximations are not proof records.
svg.text: One affine rule: ft(z) = t + z/c. Colors identify the outermost digit t.
Full E(c,n) coordinates · independently fitted views · complete depth-8 prefixes
Finite-resolution illustrations. Preset names do not turn the images into connectivity or interior certificates.
